article.headline: Brown scores 29 in Kansas City's 80-69 victory over North Dakota
article.description: — Jamar Brown's 29 points helped UMKC defeat North Dakota 80-69 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Brown scores 29 in Kansas City's 80-69 victory over North Dakota
article.story: KANSAS CITY, Mo. -- — Jamar Brown's 29 points helped UMKC defeat North Dakota 80-69 on Saturday night. Brown also contributed five rebounds for the Kangaroos (11-15, 3-8 Summit League). Cameron Faas scored 22 points and added five rebounds. Josh Ijeh shot 4 of 5 from the field to finish with nine points. The victory broke an eight-game losing streak for the Kangaroos. The Fightin' Hawks (9-17, 3-8) were led in scoring by Treysen Eaglestaff, who finished with 24 points. North Dakota also got 11 points from Deng Mayar. Mier Panoam also put up 10 points and 12 rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
